head: d6f80448fef2ca77b6eb541c4cca673489f25edc
claim: CI's done-done gate runs on a pull request only, so a push to main is green and the release workflow publishes the version instead of skipping it

runs.command:
{
  echo "CI gate event rule, read at $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) on head $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo
  echo "What this capture shows, in order:"
  echo "  a. the bug: the push to main run 39548414209 (before this change) failed at the done-done gate;"
  echo "  b. the fix: the done-done job's condition now runs it on a pull request only;"
  echo "  c. that condition's false side is real: in this same workflow a step guarded by"
  echo "     github.event_name == 'pull_request' ran in the pull request run and did not run in the push"
  echo "     to main run, while the step guarded by github.event_name == 'push' did the opposite;"
  echo "  d. the aggregate: a job skipped by design passes ci-ok, so the push to main run is green;"
  echo "  e. the release: a green push to main CI run triggers the Release workflow."
  echo
  echo "1. The bug, in the push to main run's own job log (run 39548414209, event push, before this change; this is the run the fix removes):"
  gh-axi run view 39548414209 --job 119051848588 --log 2>&1 | grep -o 'FAIL: receipt head[^\\]*'
  gh-axi run view 39548414209 2>&1 | grep -E 'done-done,completed|ci-ok,completed'
  echo
  echo "2. The fix: the job that judges the receipt (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job done-done):"
  awk '/^  done-done:$/{p=1} p&&/^  [a-z0-9-]+:$/&&!/^  done-done:$/{exit} p' .github/workflows/ci.yml
  echo
  echo "3. The same event condition, evaluated by GitHub on real runs of this workflow. The check job"
  echo "   guards its two release lint steps by the event (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job check):"
  grep -A 2 'name: Release lint' .github/workflows/ci.yml
  echo "   the release lint steps that ran, read from each run's check job log:"
  echo -n "   run 39548414209 (push to main): "
  gh-axi run view 39548414209 --job 119051848705 --log 2>&1 | grep -oE 'Release lint \((main push|PR)\)' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
  echo
  echo -n "   run 39549914720 (pull request): "
  gh-axi run view 39549914720 --job 119056562572 --log 2>&1 | grep -oE 'Release lint \((main push|PR)\)' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
  echo
  echo "   So on a push to main github.event_name == 'pull_request' is false, and the done-done job is skipped."
  echo
  echo "4. The aggregate that decides whether CI is green (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job ci-ok):"
  awk '/^  # The one required check/{p=1} p' .github/workflows/ci.yml
  echo "   and what it did on a real run where 15 jobs were skipped by their own area (run 39549914720, a pull request):"
  gh-axi run view 39549914720 2>&1 | awk '/,skipped$/{n++} END{print "   jobs skipped by their own area: " n}'
  gh-axi run view 39549914720 2>&1 | grep -E 'done-done,completed|ci-ok,completed'
  echo "   A skipped job is not a failure, so on a push to main, where the done-done job is skipped, ci-ok is green."
  echo
  echo "5. What publishes the release (.github/workflows/release.yml, job publish):"
  awk '/^  publish:$/{p=1} p&&/runs-on:/{print; exit} p' .github/workflows/release.yml
} > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/ci-gate-event.log" 2>&1
